messages.author: 9a06928e62f03e3a
messages.subject: Error Installing dartR on R v4.2.3-arm64
parts:
Hi dartR community,

I recently upgraded my install of R and R Studio and am now having trouble installing dartR. I am running R-4.2.3-arm64 (I have a Mac with an M1 chip) and RStudio-2023.03.0-386

I've completed the following steps without any errors:
install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR")
library(dartR) 

And I see the nice dartR launch message after loading the package :) I then run the following to install any missing packages:
gl.install.vanilla.dartR()

However, I get the following error:
Starting gl.install.vanilla.dartR
  Installing dartR from CRAN (latest version)
trying URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/macosx/big-sur-arm64/contrib/4.2/dartR_2.7.2.tgz'

Downloading GitHub repo mijangos81/ggtern@HEAD
── R CMD build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
✔  checking for file ‘/private/var/folders/p0/zd6lqw_s3pxbbtnylh7j15h80000gn/T/RtmpiyOPzI/remotes4bcc32bf87b2/mijangos81-ggtern-8bfb500/DESCRIPTION’ ...

✔  checking DESCRIPTION meta-information ...

         -----------------------------------
─  installing *source* package ‘ggtern’ ...
   files ‘build/partial.rdb’, ‘man/approved_layers.Rd’, ‘man/geom_smooth_tern.Rd’, ‘man/ggtern_package.Rd’, ‘man/mahalanobis_distance.Rd’, ‘man/position_jitter_tern.Rd’, ‘man/position_nudge_tern.Rd’, ‘man/theme_gridsontop.Rd’, ‘man/theme_ticklength.Rd’ are missing

     plot.ggplot      ggplot2
     print.ggplot     ggplot2
   Error : theme_elements.Rd:21: the condition has length > 1
   ERROR: installing Rd objects failed for package ‘ggtern’
─  removing ‘/private/var/folders/p0/zd6lqw_s3pxbbtnylh7j15h80000gn/T/RtmpcBMRQM/Rinst4c9d799264ec/ggtern’
         -----------------------------------
   ERROR: package installation failed
Error: Failed to install 'ggtern' from GitHub:
  ! System command 'R' failed

I've tried installing ggtern from CRAN, then re- running gl.install.vanilla.dartR(), but get the same error. Can't tell if there is something obvious I'm doing wrong? Any tips are much appreciated!

Thanks!

Nadya

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Error Installing dartR on R v4.2.3-arm64
parts:
Hi Nadya,

I think I fixed this bug. Could you please install the developing version of dartR as follows:

> library(dartR)
> gl.install.vanilla.dartR(flavour = "dev") 

Then to install the other packages that dartR uses:

> library(dartR) 
> gl.install.vanilla.dartR()

Please let us know if it works.

Cheers,
Luis
